approvals.full_literal: **Stripe Connect** Stripe Express can deliver tax forms and let eligible connected accounts review their tax information (name, address, SSN or EIN), depending on the platform's configuration and delivery settings. Follow the tax-form instructions provided for your account; [Stripe tax-form delivery guidance](https://docs.stripe.com/connect/express-dashboard-taxes) explains these conditions and directs Express users to [Stripe Express support](https://support.stripe.com/express).
approvals.rationale: The rewritten literal is conditional provider-published capability and guidance, not a claim that Vast enabled delivery or that any account received a form. The retained source covers eligibility, configuration, personal tax information, and Express support.

basis.excerpt: Stripe Express Dashboard Starting with tax season 2021, Stripe enabled e-delivery of tax forms through the Stripe Express Dashboard . Your connected accounts can use Stripe Express to manage their tax forms, update their tax information, and manage their tax form delivery preferences. Learn more about working with your users to collect verified tax information for the upcoming tax season in the 1099 Tax Support and Communication Guide . Review a detailed product walk-through of the Stripe Express dashboard and Stripe outreach to your eligible connected accounts. E-delivery through the Stripe Express Dashboard is available to connected accounts that already have access to the Express Dashboard and accounts where you’ve built and managed the full process otherwise. If you set up Connect embedded components or didn’t enable delivery through an interface built by Stripe, we won’t invite your Connected accounts to the Stripe Express Dashboard.
basis.support_rationale: Exact conditional provider capability and support route. Source-specific limit: Platform configuration and recipient eligibility are conditional; this does not establish Vast tax-form configuration or obligation. Remaining occurrence scope: Does not assert Vast has enabled a particular integration or that a form will be issued to a particular host.

approvals.full_literal: **PayPal** PayPal's [tax-form delivery guidance](https://www.paypal.com/us/cshelp/article/how-do-i-get-a-paper-copy-of-my-tax-form-help672) says eligible forms are posted to the account and emailed, and explains where personal and business accounts find their tax documents. Use PayPal's current reporting-threshold guidance to check eligibility, and contact PayPal support with questions.
approvals.rationale: The literal attributes delivery, threshold condition, and personal/business document destinations to PayPal guidance. Checking current eligibility and contacting support are advice, not an asserted account outcome.

basis.excerpt: If you're eligible to receive a tax form (e.g., Form 1099-K, 1099-INT), we'll post the form to your account and email it to you. If you also need an additional paper copy, please contact us . Note: We won't issue a Form 1099-K if you don't meet the reporting thresholds . Here’s how to locate your tax documents: Personal accounts go to the PayPal Statements & Tax Center on your desktop or from within the app . Business accounts go to the Tax Statement page .
